column1: # The aterm community theme pack: one row per theme. README.md says what each
# column means and how to add a theme. aterm-theme-pack's build script reads
# this file; `<id>.conf` and ATTRIBUTION.md are generated from it (never
# A built-in theme's source licence is LICENSES/<spdx>-<repo>.txt, found by
# that rule from the built-in's own source (no row lists it).
# @withdrawn <id> <theme>: an id a release shipped that left the pack, and
# the theme (a pack id or a built-in) that stands for it now. An id is what
# `aterm theme install` and `theme =` take, so a shipped one is never
# renamed: the `name` column re-spells what the chooser shows instead.
